question: Find the surface area of a sphere whose diameter is equal to 98 cm.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Radius (r) = 98 ÷ 2 = 49 cm.

Surface Area = 4 × π × r²

⇒ 4 × (22/7) × 49 × 49

⇒ 88 × 343 = 30,184 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 30,184 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Diameter of the sphere (d) = 98 cm

**Formula Used:**

Surface Area of a sphere = 4πr²

 
 

 

 
• 
 
 
• 
 r = 49 cm
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 Diameter = 98 cm

**Calculations:**

⇒ Radius (r) = d ÷ 2 = 98 ÷ 2 = 49 cm

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × (22/7) × 49²

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × 22 × 7 × 49

⇒ Surface Area = 88 × 343

⇒ Surface Area = 30,184 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 30,184 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Sphere

The total space occupied by a 3D sphere is given by the formula V = (4/3)πr³.

Curved Surface Area of a Hemisphere

When a full sphere is cut directly in half, its outer curved boundary area is given by CSA = 2πr².

Total Surface Area of a Hemisphere

The total overall area (which includes both the outer curved boundary and the flat circular base top) is given by TSA = 3πr².
